skill.name: dotnet-init

content.value_statement: New and existing .NET projects need guidance that matches their architecture, technology choices, and conventions. This skill guides initialization and customizes CLAUDE.md with explicit choices for preserving existing content.
actual_capabilities: Guides project detection using solution files, project SDK types, and references, asking questions when the project type is unclear.
Outlines greenfield solution scaffolding with source and test folders, .NET 10 defaults, and dotnet templates.
Asks architecture questions about domain complexity, team size, module boundaries, and existing conventions.
Collects database, authentication, caching, messaging, and testing choices for customized CLAUDE.md guidance.
Requires merge, overwrite, or keep choices for existing CLAUDE.md files, with backups before merge or overwrite.
Directs setup verification through MCP configuration checks, solution discovery, health checks, or a greenfield build.
limitations: The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md; referenced templates, companion skills, and the dotnet-architect agent are not included.
Scaffolding and build verification require an installed .NET SDK that supports the requested templates and options.
Architecture and technology selection require user input; project detection can be ambiguous.
MCP server installation details are not provided, and setup verification does not establish production readiness.

use_cases.title: Configure a Shared Library

best_practices: Confirm the project type and architecture recommendation before generating guidance or scaffolding files.
Choose merge or keep when existing CLAUDE.md contains custom guidance, and verify the backup before replacement.
Provide the referenced templates and companion skills, then review generated guidance and verification results.
anti_patterns: Overwriting existing CLAUDE.md without choosing a handling option or creating the required backup.
Selecting architecture from project size alone without discussing domain complexity and module boundaries.
Assuming initialization installs missing dependencies or proves the application is ready for production.

faq.question: Can this skill initialize an existing .NET project?
faq.answer: Yes. It directs solution and project inspection, asks architecture questions, and incorporates existing conventions into CLAUDE.md.

faq.question: What happens if CLAUDE.md already exists?
faq.answer: It asks you to merge, overwrite, or keep the file. Merge and overwrite require a CLAUDE.md.bak backup first.

faq.question: Which project types does it recognize?
faq.answer: The workflow covers Web APIs, Blazor applications, worker services, class libraries, and modular monoliths. It asks for clarification when detection is ambiguous.

faq.question: Does the package include its templates and companion skills?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md and references templates, three companion skills, and a dotnet-architect agent supplied elsewhere.

faq.question: Which .NET defaults does it propose?
faq.answer: Greenfield scaffolding proposes .NET 10 defaults, source and test folders, and xUnit with Testcontainers. Your SDK must support the requested templates.

faq.question: Does initialization verify the project?
faq.answer: It directs MCP configuration checks and an existing-project health baseline or a greenfield build. These checks do not establish production readiness.
